name: m7-local-model-routing
title: M7 Local Model Routing And Benchmark
description: Add provider routing, fallback and circuit-breaker contracts plus reproducible model/embedding benchmark metadata without fabricating GPU or vLLM results.
scope: provider route descriptors; timeout/rate-limit/server-error fallback; circuit breaker; health probes; embedding dimension isolation; benchmark schema and reports
creator: developer
notes: M7 local routing and immutable reviewed evidence remain valid. Release v0.1.32 retires the unavailable glm-5-2 route and the server-unreachable DeepSeek fallback, then records a validated openai_compatible grok-4.6 primary with no approved fallback. The reviewed deployment, authenticated business smoke, and the two targeted failure cases citation-contract-dispute and fact-retention-legal-hold all passed without repair or fallback; the sealed targeted report records two provider requests, complete token usage, and zero system failures. Real-provider repeatability remains open because the full 40-case suite was deliberately not rerun and the earlier post-v0.1.30 attempts still contain one control-plane abort and two distinct single-case system failures. Provider revision, billing amount, representative-corpus review, and human semantic review also remain open. M7-R7 GPU/vLLM/quantization capacity is explicitly excluded and must not be reported as passed or blocked work for this release.
